body: Release 4.0.0: ledger guests — participants without an account, locking, claiming on join, guests at list creation (T-364, T-365, T-366, T-367, T-368, T-370). Protocol 3 → 4, so a major release: every installed app is turned away until updated. Also carries the web test fix for the invitations flake (T-358) and the Android test diagnostics for the parallel-gate hang (T-369, still open).
title: Release 4.0.0
